context.problem: Derived metrics cannot trace to raw metric sources, making data provenance unanswerable and audit compliance impossible
drivers: ARCH-006 FAIL - Evidence Completeness test failure

decision.description: Implement source lineage tracking and data provenance system for all derived metrics
decision.implementation: Add source lineage metadata to metric extraction pipeline, track raw metric to derived metric relationships

alternatives.rejectedReason: Too late, data already processed, cannot guarantee accuracy
